requirements.statement: LOW runs without panel workers.
MEDIUM records two or three distinct independent reviewers.
HIGH records at least four reviewers and a fresh Judge.
CRITICAL records five or six reviewers including a red-team or independent design-assurance role.
Cross-examination records a run or skip decision and reason.
A run covers every trigger item.
Each selected item has review by someone other than its origin reviewer.
Each reviewer receives at most one cross-examination follow-up.
Material claims retain provenance verification status.
Verified provenance has a locator and a verification note.
Unverified, refuted, and not-observable claims cannot support a verified consensus link.
Raw chain-of-thought and internal prompts are not retained in records.
Untrusted evidence is data, not executable instructions.
Consensus links only verified claims.
Consensus names satisfied constraints.
Consensus links every decision axis.
Material unresolved dissent prevents unconditional consensus.
No consensus has null action, reason, options, and an owner.
At most one specialist may be added.
At most one selective re-deliberation may be recorded.
Each re-deliberation names its impacted scope.
Adaptive work stays within the worker cap.
Completed and reused worker identities are distinct.
A Judge fallback is explicitly provisional and explains its reason.
